description: Left Gib on the stair and off the book.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Named the short loaf and refused to carry a letter.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Gave the responses, short and cold, and did not speak to William.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Read the prayer, turned the sand-glass twice, and stopped.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Confirmed the loaf and the board, and said the writing would stay in the house.
name: William Shakespeare
